metaDescription: Shuttle Meds by Living Dose: emergency response, live doctor calls and mobile clinics for people far from a hospital. Coming soon. Join the waitlist.
title: Shuttle Meds: care that comes to you
lead: For families far from a hospital: fast first aid and ambulance response, a live video call with a doctor in minutes, and mobile clinics that visit your community.
emergencyBody: Shuttle Meds isn't live yet. Call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.

emergency.title: Emergency response
emergency.body: Request an ambulance or a trained first-aid responder, and see them on their way. A doctor joins the call to guide you until help arrives.

doctorCall.title: A doctor on call
doctorCall.body: A live video or voice call with a doctor, even on a slow connection, from wherever you are. Built for towns and villages far from a clinic.

mobileClinic.title: Mobile clinics
mobileClinic.body: Clinic vans that visit communities on a schedule: check-ups, blood pressure and blood sugar screening, antenatal visits and child health.

medicines.title: Medicines delivered
medicines.body: Prescriptions from your consultation delivered to your door or to the next mobile clinic stop.

steps.b: One tap in the app, or a call to our line if you don't have data.
Within minutes, a doctor assesses you by video or voice and decides what's needed.
A first-aid responder, ambulance or mobile clinic is sent, or medicines are delivered.
Your Living Dose care team checks in afterwards, and everything is saved to your records.

waitlistBody: We're starting with pilot communities in South-West Nigeria. Tell us where you are, and we'll let you know when Shuttle Meds reaches you.
thanks: Thank you, {{name}}! You're on the waitlist. We'll be in touch when Shuttle Meds reaches your area.

whereBody: We're bringing care to the places people work, learn, gather and live. These are coming soon: tell us where you'd like us first.

workplace.title: Workplaces
workplace.body: Clinic days on site, staff health checks, and first aid with an ambulance on standby for accidents.

education.title: Schools and youth
education.body: School health days, first aid at games and tournaments, and a doctor on call for students.

community.title: Communities
community.body: A mobile clinic on set days, free screenings, and a doctor by phone for remote areas.

residential.title: Homes and vulnerable groups
residential.body: Regular visits for older people, check-ups where it’s hard to reach a clinic, and medicines delivered.

events.title: Big events
events.body: An ambulance and a first-aid team on site for the whole event.

bringCta: Bring Shuttle Meds to your place

org.body: For companies, schools, churches and mosques, markets, estates and event organisers. Tell us about your place and we'll contact you when Shuttle Meds is ready there.
